landing.heroSubtitle: Streamline invoicing, track expenses, manage suppliers, and gain financial clarity. Built for growing businesses.
landing.noHiddenFees: No hidden fees. No surprises. Cancel anytime.
landing.choosePlanFits: Choose the plan that fits your business

landing.everythingNeedToRunBusiness: Everything You Need to Run Your Business
landing.comprehensiveTools: Comprehensive tools designed to save you time, reduce errors, and help your business grow
landing.salesDescription: Manage your entire sales cycle from lead to payment. Track customers, products, and invoices in one unified platform.
landing.purchaseDescription: Track every purchase from order to payment. Maintain complete visibility into your supply chain and spending.
landing.financialDescription: Track every penny in and out. Categorize expenses, monitor payments, and generate comprehensive financial reports.
landing.smartInvoicingDesc: Create professional invoices in seconds with auto-calculated VAT, customizable templates, and one-click PDF generation. Send invoices directly to clients via email.
landing.realtimeAnalyticsDesc: Monitor your revenue, expenses, and payment trends with interactive charts. Get instant insights into your business performance with comprehensive dashboards.
landing.purchaseManagementDesc: Track supplier invoices, manage purchase orders, and maintain a complete record of your business purchases. Never miss a payment deadline again.
landing.financialLedgerDesc: Keep accurate records of all financial transactions. Track payments, expenses, and maintain a complete audit trail for your accounting needs.
landing.multiCurrencyDesc: Work with 60+ currencies including USD, EUR, GBP, SAR, AED, and more. Automatic currency conversion and real-time exchange rates.
landing.teamCollaborationDesc: Role-based access control for Admin, Manager, and Employee roles. Customize permissions and control who can see and edit what.
landing.saveTimeDesc: Automate repetitive tasks and eliminate manual data entry. Focus on growing your business instead of paperwork.
landing.boostRevenueDesc: Get paid faster with professional invoicing and payment tracking. Never lose track of unpaid invoices again.
landing.eliminateErrorsDesc: Auto-calculations and validated inputs ensure 100% accuracy in your financial records.
landing.stayCompliantDesc: Built-in audit trails and accurate record keeping help you stay compliant with tax regulations.
landing.transformedFinances: Transformed how we handle our finances. We've saved countless hours and our cash flow has never been better.
landing.multiCurrencyGameChanger: The multi-currency support is a game-changer for our international operations. The best investment we've made.
landing.arabicNativeSupport: Finally, a solution that supports Arabic natively and handles all our business needs. Outstanding support team!
landing.dataSecureAnswer: Absolutely. We use bank-level encryption, JWT authentication, and multi-tenant data isolation. Your data is backed up daily and stored in secure, SOC 2 compliant data centers.
landing.importExistingData: Can I import my existing data?
landing.importExistingDataAnswer: Yes! You can easily import customers, products, invoices, and more via Excel. Our import wizard guides you through the process step by step.
landing.multiCurrencyWorksAnswer: We support 60+ currencies including USD, EUR, GBP, SAR, AED, and more. You can set your default currency and work with multiple currencies in the same system. Exchange rates are updated automatically.
landing.customizeInvoicesAnswer: Absolutely. You can customize your invoice templates with your logo, colors, and preferred layout. Generate professional PDFs that represent your brand perfectly.
landing.cancelData: What happens to my data if I cancel?
landing.cancelDataAnswer: You can export all your data at any time. We believe your data belongs to you. We also offer a data archival feature to keep historical records accessible.
landing.customerSupportAnswer: Yes! We offer email support for all plans, with priority support for Pro and Business customers. Our average response time is under 2 hours.
